sections.takeaway_fil: Ang mungkahing tiyak at may dahilan ang mas malamang na paniwalaan at tuluyang maisagawa kaysa sa pangkalahatang reklamo.
sections.takeaway_en: A suggestion that's specific and has a reason is far more likely to be believed and actually carried out than a general complaint.
